 American Airlines and Citi enhance the Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select World Elite Mastercard and the Citi / AAdvantage Business World Elite Mastercard with more ways to earn and new travel benefits 
 (English) (opens in new window) PDF 132 KB 
 American Airlines, Citi and Mastercard are refreshing two credit cards in 
 the AAdvantage ® portfolio to deliver greater value across a range 
 of travel needs.
 The Citi ® / AAdvantage ® Platinum Select ® 
 World Elite Mastercard ® , designed for occasional travelers, now 
 includes more travel and lifestyle benefits and rewards on everyday 
 spending.
 The Citi ® / AAdvantage Business™ World Elite 
 Mastercard ® offers business owners new travel benefits and more 
 rewards on business spending.
 FORT WORTH, Texas, and NEW YORK — American Airlines, Citi 
and Mastercard today announced upcoming enhancements to the Citi ® / 
AAdvantage ® Platinum Select ® World Elite 
Mastercard ® and the Citi ® / AAdvantage 
Business™ World Elite Mastercard ® , bringing cardmembers 
new ways to enjoy travel benefits, earn AAdvantage ® miles and 
maximize value from everyday spending. Together with the 
introduction of the Citi ® / AAdvantage ® Globe™ Mastercard ® last year and recent 
enhancements to the Citi ® / AAdvantage ® Executive World 
Legend Mastercard ® , these updates further strengthen a card 
portfolio designed to deliver value across a range of travel needs.
 "We're continuing to evolve the Citi ® / AAdvantage ® 
portfolio to better reflect how our members live, spend and travel today," said 
American's Senior Vice President of AAdvantage ® Scott Long. "These 
new benefits are designed to deliver greater value in ways that matter most to 
our members, with rewards and experiences that fit seamlessly into their 
everyday lives and travel journeys."
 Citi / AAdvantage Platinum Select Mastercard
 The refreshed Citi ® / AAdvantage ® Platinum 
Select ® Mastercard ® is designed for occasional travelers, 
offering more ways to earn AAdvantage ® miles and new travel and 
lifestyle benefits.
 New and enhanced benefits for travel and everyday spending
 3X AAdvantage ® miles on eligible AAdvantage Hotels ® 
 bookings made on aadvantagehotels.com and eligible AAdvantage 
 Cars ® bookings made on aadvantagecars.com . 
 2X AAdvantage ® miles at gas stations, now expanded to include 
 EV charging stations.
 2X AAdvantage ® miles on select streaming services.
 2X AAdvantage ® miles on eligible Rides and Rails™ 
 purchases.
 $150 American Airlines Flight Discount, increased from $125, after 
 spending $20,000 or more in purchases during cardmembership year and renewing 
 the card.
 Up to $120 Global Entry ® or TSA PreCheck ® 
 application fee credit every four years.
 Up to $100 back in statement credits annually on inflight purchases.
 Complimentary annual Walmart+ membership ($98 in value) for primary 
 cardmembers to enjoy Free Delivery ($35 minimum for scheduled delivery 
 orders), Gas Savings and Video Streaming Choice.
 50% discount on an annual FOX One subscription.
 Travel protections, including Trip Delay Protection, Trip Cancellation & 
 Interruption Protection, Worldwide Car Rental Insurance and Lost Baggage 
 Protection. 1 
 Existing ways to earn rewards and travel benefits
 2X AAdvantage ® miles on eligible American Airlines 
 purchases.
 2X AAdvantage ® miles at restaurants.
 1X AAdvantage ® miles on all other purchases.
 1 Loyalty Point for every 1 eligible AAdvantage ® mile earned 
 from purchases.
 Up to $180 annually on Turo car rentals (up to $30 in statement credits 
 for each eligible Turo car rental trip completed).
 10% savings on eligible American Airlines Vacations℠ travel 
 packages.
 Preferred boarding on American Airlines flights for the primary 
 cardmember and up to four companions traveling on the same 
 reservation.
 First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for 
 the primary cardmember and up to four companions traveling on the same 
 reservation.
 No foreign transaction fees when traveling 
 internationally. 2 
 “Our long-standing partnership with American Airlines continues to evolve 
 to meet the needs of all types of travelers,” said Citi’s Head of Partnership 
 Cards and Development for U.S. Consumer Cards John LaCosta. “By expanding the 
 ways cardmembers can earn rewards and adding benefits that extend beyond 
 travel, we’re giving customers more value from their cards, whether they 
 travel occasionally or fly every week for business.”
 Citi / AAdvantage Business Mastercard
 The enhanced Citi ® / AAdvantage Business™ 
Mastercard ® offers business owners more ways to earn 
AAdvantage ® miles for their business, greater flexibility for 
business spending and new travel benefits.
 New benefits and earning opportunities for business spending and 
travel
 3X AAdvantage® miles on eligible AAdvantage Hotels ® bookings made on aadvantagehotels.com and eligible AAdvantage Cars ® bookings made on aadvantagecars.com . 
 2X AAdvantage ® miles on an eligible Self-Select Category of 
 the cardmember’s choice: U.S. shipping providers, office supply stores or 
 U.S. advertising services.
 Up to $120 Global Entry ® or TSA PreCheck ® 
 application fee credit every four years.
 Up to $100 back in statement credits annually on inflight purchases.
 25% off a Melio subscription plan to help manage business payments.
 Travel protections, including Enhanced Trip Cancellation and Trip 
 Interruption, Lost or Damaged Luggage, MasterRental (Car Rental) and Trip 
 Delay.
 Existing earning opportunities and travel benefits
 2X AAdvantage ® miles on eligible American Airlines 
 purchases.
 2X AAdvantage ® miles at car rental merchants.
 2X AAdvantage ® miles at gas stations.
 2X AAdvantage ® miles at telecommunication merchants and cable 
 and satellite providers.
 1X AAdvantage ® miles on all other purchases.
 1 Loyalty Point for every $1 spent on business card purchases by each 
 cardmember (primary and employees). Primary cardmembers will also earn 1 
 additional Loyalty Point for every $1 spent by any Authorized Users on 
 eligible business card purchases through Dec. 31, 2028.
 $99 American Airlines Companion Certificate for a qualifying single 
 round-trip Main Cabin domestic flight after $30,000 in purchases each 
 cardmembership year and cardmembership is renewed.
 10% savings on eligible American Airlines Vacations℠ travel 
 packages.
 Preferred boarding on American Airlines flights for the primary 
 cardmember and up to four companions traveling on the same reservation.
 First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for the 
 primary cardmember and up to four companions traveling on the same 
 reservation.
 No foreign transaction fees when traveling 
 internationally. 3 
 “The strongest partnerships create value that reflects the way consumers 
 travel, explore and experience the world,” said Mastercard's Executive Vice 
 President, U.S. Market Development Kiki Del Valle. “Together with American 
 Airlines and Citi, we are reimagining this card portfolio bringing the best 
 of Mastercard by combining premium travel benefits, meaningful consumer 
 benefits, added protections and priceless experiences that help cardmembers 
 get more from every journey.”
 Beginning Jan. 24, 2027, existing Citi ® / AAdvantage ® 
Platinum Select ® Mastercard ® and Citi ® / 
AAdvantage Business™ Mastercard ® cardmembers will have 
access to the new and enhanced benefits, and both cards will have an annual fee 
of $150 2,3 . For more information, visit citicards.citi.com/usc/aaplatinumrefresh and citicards.citi.com/usc/aabusinessrefresh .

 About American Airlines Group (NASDAQ: AAL) 
American Airlines is a premium global airline connecting more of the U.S. to 
the world. With roots tracing back to an air mail carrier in the Midwestern 
United States in 1926, American now operates more than 6,000 daily flights to 
more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries and serves more than 200 
million customers annually. Powered by a proud and talented team of 130,000 
aviation professionals, American’s team lives out the airline’s purpose of 
caring for people on life’s journey every day.
 The world’s largest airline proudly celebrates its centennial year in 2026, 
reaching a milestone that reflects a century of innovation and the Forever 
Forward℠ spirit that changed the industry and the world. American introduced 
the first scheduled air cargo service, the first airport lounge and the first 
airline loyalty program and continues to reinvent the customer experience 
today. The airline is also a founding member of the one world 
alliance, whose members serve more than 900 destinations around the globe.
 Get the latest about American at news.aa.com and @AmericanAir .
 About Citi 
Citi is a preeminent banking partner for institutions with cross-border 
needs, a global leader in wealth management and a valued personal bank in its 
home market of the United States. Citi does business in more than 180 countries 
and jurisdictions, providing corporations, governments, investors, institutions 
and individuals with a broad range of financial products and services.
 Additional information may be found at www.citigroup.com | X: @Citi | LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/citi | YouTube: www.youtube.com/citi Facebook: www.facebook.com/citi 
 1 Benefits are subject to terms, conditions and limitations. 
 2 Pricing for the Citi ® / 
AAdvantage ® Platinum Select ® 
Mastercard ® : The standard variable APR for purchases is 
19.74% - 29.74% based on your creditworthiness. Balance transfers and Citi Flex 
Plan are also subject to the standard purchase variable APR. The standard 
variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. The variable Penalty APR is up to 
29.99% and may be applied if you make a late payment or make a payment that is 
returned. The annual fee for this credit card is $99 as of 10/27/26. The annual 
fee for this credit card will be $150 as of 1/24/27. However, this fee is 
waived for the first 12 months of account opening. Minimum interest charge is 
$0.50. Fee for foreign purchases - none. Cash advance fee - either $10 or 5% of 
the amount of each cash advance, whichever is greater. Balance transfer fee - 
either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater. Rates as 
of 10/27/26.
 3 Pricing for the Citi ® / 
AAdvantage Business™ Mastercard ® : The standard 
variable APR for purchases is 19.74% - 28.74%, based on your creditworthiness. 
The standard variable APR for cash advances is 29.99%. The variable Penalty APR 
is up to 29.99% and may be applied if you make a late payment or make a payment 
that is returned. The annual fee for this credit card is $99 as of 10/27/26. 
The annual fee for this credit card will be $150 as of 1/24/27. However, this 
fee is waived for the first 12 months. Minimum interest charge - $0.50. Fee for 
Foreign Purchases - None. Cash advance fee - either $10 or 5% of the amount of 
each cash advance, whichever is greater. Rates as of 10/27/26.
